categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in IC design, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of various integrated circuits including touch control chips, active stylus control chips, MEMS microphone chips, mixed-signal microcontrollers, battery management chips, and communication-related chips. It also provides design services and solutions for touch panel modules and related applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include projected capacitive multi-point touch control, capacitive active stylus touch control, MEMS microphone technology, mixed-signal microcontroller design, and battery management integrated circuits with low power consumption and high precision. The company leverages advanced IC design methodologies and collaborates with foundries like UMC for manufacturing, focusing on cost competitiveness and performance enhancement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in consumer electronics, industrial control, automotive touch products, notebook and tablet manufacturers, and medical electronics sectors. The company serves global brands and OEMs, with applications spanning smartphones, tablets, notebooks, interactive whiteboards, home medical devices, and lithium battery-powered products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with significant sales in Asia, including China, and extends its market reach globally through partnerships and distributors. It maintains R&D and corporate headquarters in Hsinchu, Taiwan, and has subsidiaries and investments in China and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as an IC design house. It designs chips and sells them either directly to electronic product manufacturers or through agents and solution providers. Manufacturing is outsourced to foundries and packaging/testing firms downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing projected capacitive touch and active stylus chip performance, expanding MEMS microphone chip applications, and developing next-generation battery management ICs with low power and high precision. The company emphasizes integration of new technologies like AI applications, expanding into industrial and automotive markets, and increasing market share through innovation and customer service.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of integrated circuits and related design services. The company also earns from licensing and royalties associated with its IC designs and solutions. Sales are made directly to manufacturers and through distributors to end customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Competitors include domestic and international IC design firms such as Goodix, Himax, Synaptics, and others in touch and mixed-signal IC markets. The company positions itself as a competitive player with a focus on high-precision analog and mixed-signal ICs, leveraging innovation and customer service to increase market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$738.56 million in 2024, a significant increase from the previous year, with a net profit of around NT$472.9 million. Despite challenges from inventory adjustments and market demand fluctuations, the company maintains profitability and invests heavily in R&D, with a growth trajectory supported by product diversification and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-precision, low-power consumption IC designs with strong integration capabilities, supporting multiple touch sensor types and active stylus protocols. Its products offer competitive cost-performance ratios, rapid engineering support, and tailored solutions for diverse applications including consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, and medical devices, differentiating through innovation and comprehensive customer service.
